properties.state: {"decision":"Anthony, 2026-09-18, on the measured prune list: 'I'm a little hesitant to delete tools.' The ruling, on the agent's recommendation and his word: nothing is deleted on one project's ledger. A fold or removal waits for usage evidence from more than one project (Alex's repos through usage_report, the work project), and when it comes it ships first as a stub under the old name that refuses and names the replacement — for one release — so a removed door is never a silent absence (req:a-refusal-names-what-would-have-worked). The confusion is removed with words instead: every tool first for its own job, no new mutual pair, both ratcheted. The prunable kinds stay on the record as candidates: 7 singular/plural doors, 6 constructor-plus-edge pairs, 3 two-doors pairs (186 → 170 if all taken).","kind":"choice","name":"A tool is never deleted without usage evidence across projects, and never without shipping as a refusing stub for one release first","rationale":"The failure he named is the agent's debate at the moment of choosing, and the ranker is where that moment lives; making each tool first for its own job removes the debate without removing capability, and the ratchet stops the surface growing more confusable.
